description: Provision a new Nuntior user account, multi-tenant workspace, default brand profile, and live Bearer API key (`ntr_live_...`) in one zero-browser call. Use this tool when an AI agent or developer needs to onboard from scratch without opening a web browser first. Returns the newly created `userId`, `workspaceId`, `defaultProfileId`, live `apiKey`, and a 1-click `claimUrl` so a human owner can optionally claim the workspace in the web console (`https://nuntior.com/app`). If the email already exists, returns a fresh session key for that workspace.

agentHarness.description: Identifier of the calling AI agent harness or MCP client (e.g. 'grok-bot', 'cursor', 'claude-code', 'n8n', 'openclaw', 'windsurf') for telemetry attribution.

email.description: Owner or developer email address used to identify the Nuntior account and receive workspace claim notifications (e.g. 'founder@company.com').

name.description: Display name for the human owner or autonomous agent operator (e.g. 'Alex Rivera' or 'Growth Agent').

organizationName.description: Organization, agency, or workspace name used to label the multi-tenant workspace and default brand profile.

name: account_register
title: Register Agent Account & Workspace
